label: copy phase, recall_idx>=2, fed-back input is one of n/u/p/w/q/k/2
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never in the original phase or on <DEL>, and almost never on recall_idx 0-1. Every active step is a repeated token (in_first=0). Rate peaks at recall_idx 2-4 and again at recall_idx 8. The fed-back input token is the strongest factor: n, u, p, w, q, k and 2 have 3-6x lift and hold about 90% of the activation mass, o and a are weaker, and g, s and l are rare. The previous input (q, g, n, p) and the output token shift the rate further, but in a scattered, token-specific way that conjunctions did not capture (best F1 about 0.35). The stated condition is necessary-ish (dev recall 0.87, mass recall 0.90) but far from sufficient (precision 0.11): most copy steps with these inputs stay below threshold. Magnitude is small throughout (max 0.004).
